title: Adopt the Máquina Factory Contract
objective: Install a small Swift-aware Factory Contract, matching policy rules, agent guidance, and base-resident bootstrap intents without enabling a remote evaluator before its policy is trusted.
acceptance_criteria: The Factory Contract validates from the Beadle repository root.
Policy rules encode the same capabilities with zero reported drift.
The default profile names swift build and git diff --check because Beadle has no Swift test target.
The advisory Action remains disabled until the contract and workflow intent are base-resident.
